title: Termination Refund Computation, Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda
content:
# Termination Refund Computation, Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda

The refund owed when a Kessler GAP waiver is terminated after its lienholder reports the installment contract paid off or refinanced away is defined as follows.

**Who is in scope.** A waiver with no loan payoff date on file, or one carrying a submitted signed cancellation request, is not terminated under this rule, and its termination refund is 0.00.

**Starting point and date.** The termination refund starts from the waiver's price. The effective date of the termination is the loan payoff date the lienholder reported.

**The refund.** The termination refund is the waiver's price times the unused termination share, rounded half up to the cent, less the cancellation fee of the waiver's tier; no fee is deducted where the tier waives the cancellation fee on payoff. The unused termination share is the calendar days from the loan payoff date to the expiration date divided by the calendar days from the sale date to the expiration date. A termination refund below 0.00 is 0.00.

**Unwound deal.** Where the tier refunds an unwound deal in full (every tier of the program does), a waiver whose purchase deal has been unwound is refunded its full price on termination, with the refund basis "flat, deal unwound"; every other termination refund has the refund basis "pro rata".

## Fee position by tier

| Tier | Cancellation fee | Fee waived on payoff |
|---|---|---|
| Kessler GAP Waiver 125 | 50.00 | No |
| Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 | 50.00 | No |
| Kessler GAP Waiver 150 | 50.00 | Yes |
| Kessler GAP Plus 150 | 50.00 | Yes |
| Kessler GAP Plus 175 | 50.00 | Yes |
| Kessler GAP Commercial 130 | 75.00 | No |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A Kessler GAP Waiver 125 priced 681.00 runs 1,826 calendar days from sale date to expiration date; the lienholder reports the loan paid off with 1,200 calendar days left.

- Price times share: 681.00 times 1,200 divided by 1,826 is 447.5356..., rounded half up to 447.54.
- Less the 50.00 fee: the termination refund is 397.54, refund basis pro rata.
- The same waiver held as a Kessler GAP Waiver 150 would carry no fee: 447.54.
- Had the purchase deal been unwound, the refund would be the full 681.00 with the basis flat, deal unwound.
